source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

wall_dimension_report.scope: caller-supplied endpoint semantics; no image verdict, calibration fitting or geometry mutation

assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.
Plan top edge = North, bottom edge = South, left = West, right = East, consistent with seed.

Overlay calibration_001 for 1f_view.png/F1 (x: 420px=0m,1805px=15m; y: 336px=8m,1070px=0m; ~10.85-10.9mm/px both axes) is used as the checked registered frame; it shows a small 0.63% cross-axis scale disagreement (over the tool's 0.3% strict threshold) and an 8000mm chain residual of -39mm, both left as recorded calibration warnings rather than forced to zero.

F1 partitions at x=4.94m/x=9.82m and both facades (north y=8, west x=0) were re-documented as wall_references citing both original dimension-chain/pixel-band evidence and the new overlay cross-check; the two previously contradictory wall_dimensions entries (dim-north-240, dim-west-240), which duplicated a single 240mm thickness label as a same-wall chain with inconsistent side/direction labels (same_wall_endpoint_order finding), were removed rather than force-closed; thickness for those two facades stays at the directly observed 240mm.
F1 door and window openings (8 doors, 7 windows) were reviewed against 1f_view.png door swings and window hatch marks with coverage=complete for both kinds on F1; all matched with no findings.

unresolved: Individual thickness/offset split of the aggregate 240mm gap between the two F1 north-row partitions (x=4.94m, x=9.82m) remains unknown; only the combined jog-gap evidence exists.

The F1 corridor partition walls (y=3m/y=5m) still show a west-chain (3000/250/1500/250/3000=8000mm, closes exactly) vs east-chain (2940/340/1200/340/2940=7760mm, -240mm residual, differing 250mm vs 340mm flank reading) discrepancy inherited from the prior pass; this is a two-room shared boundary not representable by the current wall_references/move_shared_wall tooling without further evidence, so representative planes are left at the seed position and this is reported here rather than silently dropped.

F2 (2f_view.png) walls, partitions and openings were NOT re-examined or recalibrated this pass; only F1/1f_view.png received a checked overlay calibration and opening review this session. F2 fidelity, the previously-noted ~2.7% 2f_view cross-axis calibration disagreement, and the F2 ConfA/ConfB door split remain exactly as inherited from the seed, unresolved.

Only F1 north-row partitions, the two named F1 facades, and F1 door/window openings were checked against image evidence this pass; all other F1 interior partition faces (e.g. F1 south-row partitions at x=4.82/x=9.82 on the south side) were not independently re-verified for the same jog-mark ambiguity.
Door swing direction/leaf handedness and room role labels (S1/N2 etc.) were not verified against the drawing this pass.

scope.actual_openings: only explicit built source openings are inventoried
